Company snapshot: Aurum Helix builds a CRM-integrated customer support platform used by multiple European telcos. Primary ambition: reduce average handle time by 25% while improving CSAT through better agent guidance and faster, more accurate article retrieval.

POC scope and success metrics:
- Workloads: agent_assist (real-time suggestions), ticket_summarization (end-of-interaction), tool_calling (automated triage ops via integrations), and RAG-backed KB retrieval with citation + freshness scoring.
- Targets: 95th percentile response latency <= 250ms for agent suggestions under normal load; spike tolerance to 5x concurrent agents for up to 20 minutes with graceful degradation; summarization throughput of 1200 tickets/hour in batch POC.
- Quality: citation accuracy > 92% on curated eval set; summary compression ratio target 6x with key facts preserved.
- Cost: prefer Dedicated for predictable throughput; will evaluate Optimize suggestions for batching/quantization tradeoffs.

Tech notes / constraints:
- Data sources for RAG: product docs (Confluence), Zendesk tickets, internal telemetry (Elasticsearch), and release notes. Must support multi-source retrieval with source-level freshness and citation links in the agent UI.
- Vector store preference: currently testing Weaviate and Pinecone; open to Redwood recommendations.
- Concern: hallucination on rare edge cases. Request automated citation alignment and show provenance snippets.
- Security: must run in EU region, VPC or on_prem option required for pilot, KMS-managed keys, SSO via SAML, retention controls for transcripts.
